## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

What is intentionally included and excluded?

## Testing

- [ ] Frontend build passes
- [ ] Rust formatting passes
- [ ] Rust Clippy passes
- [ ] Rust tests pass
- [ ] Manual workflow test completed

## Security and Privacy

Describe any effect on permissions, files, persistent data, logs, approvals, secrets, or personal information.

## Screenshots

Include screenshots for user-interface changes when useful.

## Documentation

- [ ] README remains accurate
- [ ] Architecture documentation updated if needed
- [ ] Changelog updated if needed
- [ ] Known limitations documented

## Final Checklist

- [ ] The change has one clear purpose
- [ ] No secrets or personal data are included
- [ ] Temporary debugging code has been removed
- [ ] Error, loading, and empty states were considered
- [ ] Commit history is understandable
